parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own Twist destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-twist` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`). The gateway composes an Apprise `twist://` URL from the credentials in your stored secrets and delivers the notification via apprise.unitysvc.dev, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two channels are available: the free `apprise` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `apprise-plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters.

email_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Twist email

password_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Twist password
